title: Data Deletion - Jawab24
metaDescription: Facebook & Instagram Data Deletion Instructions for Jawab24
intro: This page explains how users can request deletion of their data associated with Jawab24 and its integration with Meta platforms (Facebook and Instagram).
howToDeleteText: If you want to delete your data from Jawab24, you have several options:
option1Step1: Log in to your Jawab24 account at
option1Note: This will permanently delete all your data including connected pages, comments, messages, and settings.
option2Step4: Check the box to delete all data
option3Text: You can also request data deletion by contacting us directly:
option3Note: Please include your Facebook account email or Page name in your request.
metaDataIntro: When you use Jawab24 with Facebook or Instagram, the following data may be stored:
metaItemPageIds: Facebook Page IDs connected to Jawab24
metaItemWebhooks: Comment and message identifiers received via Meta Webhooks
metaItemTokens: Access tokens used to communicate with the Meta Graph API
processingTimeText: Data deletion requests are typically processed within 7 days of receiving the request.
revokeAccessText: Users can also revoke Jawab24 access directly from their Facebook account settings by removing the Jawab24 application under
dataRetentionText: After deletion, your data will be permanently removed from our servers within 90 days. Some data may be retained in encrypted backups for a limited period for legal compliance.
statusMetaDescription: Check the status of your Jawab24 data deletion request.
statusReceived: We have received your data deletion request and removed the associated data from our systems.
statusProcessedNote: Any remaining copies in encrypted backups are permanently removed within 90 days, in line with our data retention policy.
statusNoCode: No confirmation code was provided. If you are checking a specific request, please use the link from your confirmation.
